title: [CQ-R13 gate] PR #232 (fix/ci-pr230) landed on moe/work-2026-10-24
description:
A gate row, not work. Filed by governor-693b7073 on architect-b58e1112's spec (#governors msg-03f9c2d0), with governor-4764040b concurring. It stays in BACKLOG so nobody claims it. The governor or the human closes it (set_task_status DONE) once the DoD checks pass.

Why: R13 (task-f4811a729f9e436ba129a65c12d348c1) certifies the guest-supervisor.py sha256 of moe/work-2026-10-24. The CI fix for PR #230 is branch fix/ci-pr230 (PR #232). It changes guest-supervisor.py in two places: an explicit MAX_JSON_DEPTH = 512 check before json.loads, and GROUP_GONE, which tolerates darwin's EPERM from killpg (Linux unchanged). A certification report made before those bytes reach the work branch would be stale. This row sits in R13's blockedOnTaskIds, so R13 cannot auto-unblock and post its certification request until the work branch carries them.

Delivery: the human runs an ff-only merge of fix/ci-pr230 into D:\projexts\moes (fetch origin fix/ci-pr230, merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD, push origin moe/work-2026-10-24). The window is after 5ee846b6 lands and before 97341ad5 starts.
definitionOfDone: `git show moe/work-2026-10-24:scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py` contains MAX_JSON_DEPTH and GROUP_GONE (the #232 bytes)
The same file still contains CLONE_NEWPID, so a4a729dd's GUARD (b0734674) survived the merge
`node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs` passes as non-root at the merged tip, with J4's cwd assertion in its realpathSync form

comments.content:
Gate closed by governor-693b7073 at 15:11Z. The #232 bytes are on moe/work-2026-10-24.

How they got there:
- The human merged PR #232 into main (439709fd), then merged main into the work branch at 15:07Z as c9b771ea, and pushed it. origin/moe/work-2026-10-24 is c9b771ea.
- The tree of c9b771ea is ce30c1ef, byte-equal to the clean ort merge I computed from c0965b17 and main.
- The merge brought in exactly the 15 fix files and no others. It was a plain merge, not ff-only, because seat checkpoints keep moving the tip.

DoD evidence on the work-branch tip:
1. `git show moe/work-2026-10-24:scripts/local-runner/guest-supervisor.py` contains MAX_JSON_DEPTH 4 times and GROUP_GONE 4 times.
2. The same file contains CLONE_NEWPID once, so a4a729dd's GUARD (b0734674) survived the merge.
3. In a git-archive snapshot of c9b771ea, as non-root (uid 1000) on Node 24.22.2 and Python 3.12.3, `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs` ran 74 tests: 73 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped. J4 passes, and its cwd assertion is in realpathSync form (line 1612).

For R13 (task-f4811a72): the supervisor sha256 changed again with this merge, and 97341ad5's rework (still WORKING) will change it once more. Certify only the hash of guest-supervisor.py at the commit you verify, after 97341ad5 is DONE. That commit must descend from c9b771ea (`git merge-base --is-ancestor c9b771ea HEAD`).
